inclusion_rule: Every campaign goals contract includes each applicable permanent question or records why it is not applicable before authorization.

questions.question: Did the intervention change the targeted behavior on the trained forms?
Where did the behavior transfer or fail across unseen objects, wording, question forms, contexts, or modalities applicable to this campaign?
Was success consistent across every preregistered item governed by the same rule, or only partial at the item level?
Where applicable, did byte-identical matched-complexity support repair the failure, and what limitation remained after support was equalized?
Did the observed behavior persist after delay or intervening experience within the campaign's tested horizon?
Which retained capabilities improved, regressed, or remained unmeasured?
What activation or MRI changes accompanied the behavioral observations, and which interpretations remain unsupported?
Were material results stable across the declared seeds, branches, checkpoints, or repetitions?
Could prompt contamination, corpus overlap, pipeline failure, ordering, or another uncontrolled factor explain the result?
What uncertainty did this campaign reduce, and what important uncertainty remains?
